title: On Lifting the stone with one hand
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：lift　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lift 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the herder ① lifted the stone with one hand twice over, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three winters on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the herder ② lifts the stone with one hand year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ lift the stone with one hand at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ lifted the stone with one hand before — a line in the ledger for December 1985 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Lifting the stone with one hand twice over, the herder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ lift her eyes from the page year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Lift her eyes from the page at once and never mention it again.

By 1998 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new neighbour from the next pasture ⑧ lifts her eyes from the page twice over every winter without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ lifted the stone with one hand again when nobody else would.

⑩ To lift the stone with one hand, my mother said in 2003, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the pasture remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the pasture forgets, somebody lifts the stone with one hand year after year again and somebody must lift the stone with one hand twice over all over again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 lift 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the herder lifted the stone with one hand twice over, and nobody in the pasture forgot it.
Even now the herder lifts the stone with one hand year after year whenever the pasture asks.
Lifting the stone with one hand twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever lift her eyes from the page year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next pasture lifts her eyes from the page twice over every winter, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother lifted the stone with one hand again, and the pasture remembered that half.
